executivePulse.interpretation: Memory and AI infrastructure remain under high pressure. Server DRAM, HBM, DRAM are currently among the most constrained areas. The Daily Check of 2026-08-16 reviewed eight current relevant reports; there is currently no confirmed material change in direction. New capacity and improved yields can relieve pressure, but will reach the market only with delay. For buyers, supply security, alternative BOMs and early procurement remain decisive.
